gen-gf-gabarito-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 is built from pixel-like dots, friendly and sans-serif. Gabarito above it draws loose, open-ended strokes, so the two feel like a handwritten sign next to a tidy label.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-doto: Doto leaves wide margins around every glyph and gives its round letters generous mouths, a plain sans feel. Yet Gabarito heads it with letterforms that look bent from one length of tubing, so the page moves from bendy to spacious.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-el-messiri: El Messiri writes with a gentle thick-thin stroke and a wide slot in its c, nothing fussy. El Messiri also gives Gabarito's pencil-flat, never-pressing letters something softer to lean against, and you would feel it if the heading shrank.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-electrolize: Electrolize opens its c like a pair of pliers, giving the sans-serif body a modern, mechanical bite beside Gabarito's technical-pen steadiness. Paragraphs would feel crisp.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-elms-sans: Gabarito draws with one nib, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Elms Sans does the quiet work, a ballpoint's pressure-free line with a see-through gap in each s.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-encode-sans: Gabarito draws every stroke without any shading from thick to thin, its counters flowing outward. And Encode Sans keeps a gap that stops c from collapsing into o, so a longer read stays crisp and tidy.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Encode Sans Expanded pulls the tips of its c shapes well apart, a sans-serif body with an approachable ease. Gabarito's tubing-cut curves feel livelier.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-encode-sans-sc: Rods, not blades. Gabarito's letters look made of rods, and Encode Sans SC, a plain sans with a shallow terminal curl and wide gap, would carry a longer passage in a steady, workmanlike way.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-encode-sans-semi-cond: Open counters, especially on the s, make this sans-serif body read smoothly and approachably. Encode Sans Semi Condensed would carry a longer passage with ease under Gabarito's constant-width pen line.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-encode-sans-semi-expa: Encode Sans Semi Expanded leaves its rounded letters open, a contemporary sans with little fuss. Encode Sans Semi Expanded stays out of the way while Gabarito's gentle, monotone line does the talking up top.
